summary.headline: Moon Aspects with Venus and Mercury
summary.text: Astrological judgments for trine and sextile aspects involving the Moon with Venus and Mercury, covering markets, weather, marriage, childbirth, news, health, scribes, merchants, and artisans. A warning explains that planets in domicile, exaltation, or term strengthen aspect judgments, while planets in fall or detriment weaken them.
